stories.script: In business. N-vidia's shares briefly hit a record on Friday, then closed just below it. Investors are back after a slump that cost it over a trillion dollars in value.
stories.screen: a small glowing chart arrow rising to a peak, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In security. Apple says it will make it harder for apps to read everything on a Mac. It blames A I agents, but has not said what changes or when.
stories.screen: a small glowing laptop with a closed padlock on its screen, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In energy. Oracle's new Wisconsin data center may run partly on nuclear power. The local power company made the deal, and the state must still approve it.
stories.screen: a small glowing atom symbol beside a server rack, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In robotics. The Pentagon may add up to fifty canoe-sized robot boats on the Rio Grande. Ten already help spot illegal crossings, but no decision has been made.
stories.screen: a small glowing canoe-shaped boat on wavy water lines, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In science. Meta says mathematicians working with its Muse Spark chatbot answered five unsolved maths questions. The claim is Meta's own, and other teams solved some of them too.
stories.screen: a glowing light bulb beside a small checkmark, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In health. Fewer high-risk patients died at eleven hospitals after A I alerts called in emergency teams. It only compared before and after, so the cause is not proven.
stories.screen: a glowing heartbeat line with a small bell above it, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In society. Pope Leo wrote online that telling human art from machine art is becoming urgent. He wrote that algorithms lack the spark of humanity.
stories.screen: a small glowing paintbrush beside an artist's palette, simple text-free symbol

fun.script: And a lighter story. An Airbnb host reportedly backed a flooded toilet bill with an A I photo. Google's chatbot then found its own hidden watermark in the picture.
fun.screen: a small glowing toilet with water drops beside a magnifying glass, simple text-free symbol

teaser.script: Also in the full report: Trading in future A I computing power may be coming. And China's heavy buying of chip-making machines reportedly sparked US calls for an export ban.
teaser.screen: an open book with glowing pages, simple text-free symbol

bp.script: And for the bigger picture: A I is now about who gets paid, and at what price. Businesses pay less for it, while memory chips may cost more. Watch whether A I computing power starts trading Monday.
bp.screen: a glowing globe wrapped in connecting lines, simple text-free symbol
